Electrical Engineer Job at CME Engineering Limited




        
    

        
        CME Engineering Limited is a reputable company specializing in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and Contracting services. Founded with a clear vision to deliver exceptional engineering solutions, we have consistently executed projects that uphold the highest standards of quality, innovation, and client satisfaction.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Electrical Engineer
Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineer with at least 2- 4years of hands-on project experience.
	The role involves designing, implementing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems.
	The successful candidate will support projects from design to handover while ensuring compliance with codes and client specifications.


Key Responsibilities:


	Prepare and review electrical design drawings, single-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, and specifications for projects.
	Perform load calculations, cable sizing, short-circuit analysis, and protection coordination studies.
	Support the selection and specification of electrical equipment including switchgear, transformers, motors, generators, UPS systems, and lighting.
	Coordinate with other engineering disciplines (mechanical, civil, instrumentation) and project stakeholders to ensure integrated design solutions.
	Support construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities of electrical systems on project sites.
	Prepare technical reports, method statements, as-built documentation, and project handover packages.
	Identify and resolve technical issues during design and construction phases promptly.
	Promote and adhere to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) policies throughout project execution.


Requirements


	B.Eng. or HND in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.
	Minimum of 2–4 years of proven experience in electrical design, Project, and site supervision.
	COREN or NSE membership is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, and control panels.
	Familiarity with Nigerian electrical codes and international standards.
	Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For inquiries, contact 08140756552 via WhatsApp.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Accountant",
  "description": "At Dreamworks Global Logistics (DGL) Limited, we grow our clients&rsquo; businesses by listening to and understanding their needs, hence partnering with them to achieve their goals. We link manufacturers with numerous customers in over 100 cities and villages across Nigeria, getting their products to them seamlessly and rapidly.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Lagos&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
